text:
lucy_ops: FYI: vendor called — batch H200-NA->EU (PO 60111) has intermittent thermal throttling in transit-tested samples. Holding EU pool.

martin_procure: numbers? how many affected? lead time impact?

lucy_ops: sampled 240 units, 10 showed repeated thermal_trip after 20-40m burn. Not consistent. Suggest quarantine at FRA crossdock, route EU demand from US buffer for 7 days.

nexa_supply_ops: vendor initial stance: depot rework kits + 2% credit, or full air replacements at cost; expedited slice possible (30% of qty) in 5-7 days.

eva_sales: we need clarity for customers. If we can expedite 30% to EU in 5-7d, that's acceptable for top-tier. Can procurement push for better credit for remainder?

martin_procure: commercial ask: vendor covers return freight for failed units, provides depot preflight bench logs per serial, and 4% credit on PO if we accept depot repair.

nexa_supply_ops: vendor counter: 3% credit + covers return freight for failed units if we accept depot repair; expedite 30% in 5 days only if we sign limited holdback. No bench logs promise for salvage units.

hana_logistics: ops constraint: crossdock FRA needs HS amend to process as repair parts. That takes ~18-24h. If vendor needs labels tonight we'll need broker in loop.

lucy_ops: technical requirement: any reworked or replacement unit must include per-serial bench_id, therm_profile, and a KV cache retention check. We can't accept units without those.

nexa_supply_ops: pushing vendor for bench logs and preflight spec. They agreed to provide bench logs for depot-repaired units but not for salvage units unless we escalate.

emma_sales: (typo, but EVA sales is participant) eva_sales: prepare a neutral comms template: "We have quarantined a small subset of recent H200s and are prioritizing replacements for critical customers; mitigation in place." Keep it brief.

martin_procure: decision tradeoffs: 3% credit + vendor covers freight vs legal escalation and delayed replacements. Recommend accepting 3% if vendor signs preflight SLA for depot repairs and expedited 30% in 5 days.

lucy_ops: agree on expedites for critical accounts. Ops checklist: 1) run stress-test script on 32 random units, 2) tag failing serials with `rma-suspect`, 3) create crossdock order CD-60111-FRA, 4) draft RMA RMA-2026-6101 with preflight_required=true. I'll do 1-2.

rma-bot: RMA draft created RMA-2026-6101, fields: unit_count=10, requested_credit=4%, preflight_required=true.

nexa_supply_ops: vendor offered final: 3% credit + covers inbound freight for failed units + depot preflight bench logs for repaired units, expedite 30% in 5 days if RMA signed. Please confirm by EOD.

emma_sales: if vendor signs, I'll send customer message and route US buffer to EU. If they don't, escalate to procurement lead.

martin_procure: approve accepting vendor final if they add clause: replacements that fail our depot preflight must be replaced again at vendor expense within 3 days of failing. Add that to amendment.

nexa_supply_ops: vendor tentatively agrees to the 3-day re-replace SLA. They'll send commercial amendment in 3h.

lucy_ops: thanks. I'll post stress-test logs as they finish. Keep legal on standby if amendment deviates. :thumbsup:
